mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 8.0% over the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0, or the correlation between UNRATE and 5-day returns is positive.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous weakness in consumer spending (RSAFS) below 400,000 million dollars and labor market deterioration (UNRATE) above 8.0% indicates broad economic slowdown, depressing corporate profit expectations and generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS falls below 400,000 and UNRATE rises above 8.0, the 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or the interaction effect is statistically insignificant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%), rising interest rates compress equity valuations through higher discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS and 60-day returns is positive.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) above 100 (2017=100) signals strong manufacturing expansion that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO > 100, the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC between INDPRO and 20-day returns is negative.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained high employment growth (PAYEMS) indicates robust labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The correlation between PAYEMS and 20-day forward returns is negative or insignificant (p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing market weakness (HOUST < 700.0 thousand units) signals reduced consumer confidence and spending, depressing corporate revenue growth and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 700.0, the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Declining consumer spending (RSAFS < 400,000 million dollars) indicates reduced household purchasing power, weakening corporate revenue growth and generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS < 400000.0, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or the correlation is positive.
